title: Principal DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Principal DevOps & Cloud Engineer to lead our cloud platform infrastructure, Kubernetes clusters, and automated CI/CD release engineering. You will manage multi-region AWS infrastructure using Terraform and automate observability.

Qualifications:
- 4+ years managing production AWS environments and Kubernetes clusters (EKS).
- Strong proficiency in Terraform infrastructure-as-code, Docker, and GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines.
- Experience in Linux systems administration, Prometheus/Grafana monitoring, and Python/Bash scripting.
education_requirements: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
